economic_mechanism: BTCDVOL futures are linear futures on the BTC DVOL index and cash-settle to an expiry TWAP of that index. If a non-zero futures-minus-index basis contains a true convergence component, the signed basis should on average move toward zero as the contract approaches expiry.

source.accepted_contract_rule: Exact metadata instrument_name match; kind=future; price_index=btcdvol_usdc; listed life overlaps the research window; expiry before 2025-01-01.

observation_rule.ordinary_trade: Deduplicated public trade with block_trade_id and combo_id absent/null.
observation_rule.daily_anchor: For each confirmed contract and UTC calendar day, retain the first ordinary trade at or after 08:00:00 UTC and strictly before contract expiration.
observation_rule.adjacent_pair_rule: Within each contract, pair each eligible daily anchor with the next eligible daily anchor. Do not bridge across contracts.
observation_rule.elapsed_time_normalization: signed convergence score divided by positive integer UTC calendar-day gap between paired anchors.
observation_rule.signed_convergence_score: sign(basis_t) * (basis_t - basis_next) / elapsed_calendar_days. Positive means movement toward zero; negative means movement away from zero. basis_t==0 scores 0.

primary_estimand: Equal-weight mean of per-contract mean signed convergence scores (DVOL index points per calendar day).
secondary_metrics: share of contracts with positive mean signed convergence
expiration-quarter mean of per-contract mean signed convergence

bootstrap.statistic: equal-weight mean of sampled contract means

no_rescue_rule: After the canonical outcome is opened, do not change daily anchor time, basis definition, pair construction, sample gates, statistical gates, bootstrap, source period or contract population under this Discovery ID.
post_pass_rule: A PASS proves only historical basis convergence. It authorizes a separately frozen execution/cost MVE. It does not authorize live trading or a diamond classification.
